note: Granulocyte subsetting within PMN. Neutrophils: dense vertical band at high CD16 (CD16+), spanning a broad FSC range. Eosinophils: smaller vertical band at low CD16 (CD16-); CD16 is bimodal — boundary set at the valley between the two CD16 peaks. The upper saturation edge at the FSC-A axis max is excluded.
tips: Granulocyte subsetting within PMN. Neutrophils: CD16+ (FcγRIII-high). Eosinophils: CD16- (eosinophils are classically CD16-negative/low). In-panel co-marker prior: no in-panel marker positively confirms eosinophil identity — CD16 negativity within the high-SSC PMN parent is the sole discriminator, so eosinophils are defined by exclusion. Basophils (CD16- CD123+) are captured via a separate branch at Step 24, not here, and should not contaminate the PMN parent because basophils have lower SSC than granulocytes; CD123 is therefore not needed at this step.
